decisions.reason: As a small plugin close to the core shop-service stack, prior development effort and low incremental maintenance needs still favor continuation even though its public visibility has faded.

After several years and with no recent website presence, one of several overlapping price-comparison tracking plugins is easier to discontinue and fold resources into broader multichannel development.
Because it is redundant with similar tracking plugins and no longer visibly highlighted, management can now justify withdrawal despite earlier commitment and redirect effort to newer priorities.
The firm’s earlier commitment supports persistence, but by 2022 the weak public commitment and overlap with sister plugins make rationalization more likely than continued standalone offering.

This reporting add-on remains adjacent to the established optimization offering, so sunk development costs and its fit with measurable-commerce services still make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
